quest.title: The Discarded Insignia
quest.description: You meet a Fatui Electrohammer Vanguard on Minacious Isle who keeps going on about an insignia. It seems that you won't be able to get through to him... But if you find some way to bring him back to his senses, perhaps you might be able to figure out why he is here.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's try and show him the insignia...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's show him that insignia...

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: It's all my fault... I'm the reason he became like that...

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: No, I need to... bring the insignia back to him... I've got to find it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's that Fatui guy muttering about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: The insignia... The insignia...

choices.text: He doesn't look quite all there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... this does worry Paimon a little. Why is this Electrohammer Vanguard here? He isn't up to something bad, is he?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, how should we deal with this guy?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Eh, only his charging attack is any threat...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, Electrohammer Vanguards are pretty dangerous when they sprint at full tilt... Wait, no, that's not what Paimon was talking about!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What Paimon meant is... Shouldn't we, y'know, wake him up and ask him what he's doing here...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It is quite the curious thing, indeed...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. It's not every day we have a Fatuus here muttering about some insignia or whatever... It seems like he's looking for something.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This really isn't something that happens every day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, Paimon wonders what happened to leave him in this state...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It must've been that machine's fault...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, the Fatui were also affected by the machine. But isn't there anything we can do to bring him back to his senses?

response.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
response.text: I gotta find the insignia... That's the only way...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Seems like he's looking for some kind of insignia... Guess we need to find it for him, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: I don't think we're getting through to him...

talks.objective: Look for the insignia the Electrohammer Vanguard speaks of
Give the insignia to the Electrohammer Vanguard

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, is the insignia we picked up on the beach the one he's muttering about? You know, the one that looks kinda shabby?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We might as well show it to him, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's show him that insignia...

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: This is... Yeah, this is the one. I remember every scratch on this insignia. Huh, there's a new dent here. Why's that?

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: Oh right. Yakov threw it down back then, didn't he...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so that's why that insignia was in such a weird spot.

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: I see. So you found it on the beach, eh... Heh, so it was found at last. Thank you both so much. I'm lucky to have met people as kind as you are.

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: #...No, wait. You're {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #That's right. That's {NICKNAME} to you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Paimon's Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: I... I see. Now that I'm at your mercy, there's not much I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: My father once told me that "if you have fallen into enemy hands, it is a better option to sacrifice yourself for the honor of your family."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? That sounds horrible...

choices.text: Can't believe your old man actually said that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: To be honest, though, we were just curious about why you're here...

response.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
response.text: My father once told me that "giving information to the enemy is no different from betrayal. Our family raises no traitors!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's way too harsh.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Harsh indeed...

response.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
response.text: To be honest, it is truly shameful that I have fallen into your hands and even had to accept your help. That's what my father's teachings say.

response.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
response.text: To be honest, I'm so ashamed now that I want to cry!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay, we got it. Still, this isn't something to be proud of. You don't have to say it so loud.

response.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
response.text: Yet, my father also told me that "When you receive a favor, you should return it." His words seem to contradict themselves in this situation.

response.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
response.text: So I have decided to...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Have decided to do what?

response.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
response.text: Just do what I wish and tell you everything!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you sure became easygoing super quick!

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: My name is Chevka. I was carrying out signal testing work for the machine... Huh, my memory about it is a bit blurry. Anyway, I remember that we came all the way to this island...

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: Oh, yeah, and I was with Yakov. We got into a fight, and that's why he threw the insignia away.

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: Then... I saw him walking into something really abnormal and disappear along with... whatever that abnormality was. Um, this doesn't mean that I'll never see him again, right?

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: That's what I hoped, anyway, and that's how I wound up looking for a way to reunite with him here. But then there was a buzzing sound, and my mind suddenly went blank. That's how I got into the state you saw me in earlier.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A thing that disappears with you once you walk into it? Is this some kind of Golden Apple Archipelago urban legend?

choices.text: Some kind of horrifyingly warped trap?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon thinks those might be a bit off the mark. But it might just be like those strange mechanized paths we've seen before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In which case, there might just be a way to re-open the way through them!

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: Wait. You... You can open those...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we can, sure. But hey, why should we help you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're a Fatuus, you know...

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: If you can open it and help me find Yakov, I will tell you anything you want... Well, I will not speak ill of the Lord Harbingers regardless.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, that was a quick decision. You almost made us feel like the villains here... Also, hang on, did you just forget your father's teachings altogether?

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: It was my fault in the first place that Yakov was... And some things are more important than so-called principles or instructions... That's what I think, anyway.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, alright then. Let's give it a go, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: A good father would never say something like that!

talks.objective: Find a way to open the path that Yakov took

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Huh, so there was an island like this there. How strange...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: I don't remember this being here the last time when we were investigating earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it, Chevka?

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Hmm... No, it's nothing, really.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, it seems that Yakov definitely came to this island as well.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: That's right. I've got to find Yakov. I've got to! Yakov—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, didn't we tell you to relax? Stop yelling so loudly!

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Oh. Um. Sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #There's no need to be so nervous. This place is very safe. Now, {NICKNAME}, let's go look for Yakov...

dialogues.speaker: Phonograph
dialogues.text: (The gramophone is playing songs that bring back warm memories of the past...)

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: Oh... why...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Yakov, Yakov, wake up! What happened to you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You were just like him earlier, you know, muttering on about that insignia!

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Oh right, that insignia...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Yakov, look! This is your insignia. You threw it away earlier, but it's been found...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: It's an honor you earned together with your father, and now it's back in your hands... What do you say, Yakov? C'mon, man, wake up already...

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: Why... Why... Why did you leave me alone...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It doesn't seem to have helped...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: If this won't bring him back to us, then what in the world does he want...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You don't know what he's looking for? Aren't you guys teammates?

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: I... I always thought that honors were all that mattered to him. But no, I was wrong. That was just "what I thought he valued"...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: He got this badge for completing an emergency mission together with his father, but his father never returned...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: His mother passed away when he was born... So after losing his father, he was then all alone in the world.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Though he's younger than me, he'd earned more honors than I. Maybe I was... I guess I was jealous of him. I didn't even know how to get along with him. The only example I could draw from...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You got this from how your father treats you, didn't you...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Well, this is kind of embarrassing... But you guessed it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, it somehow doesn't surprise Paimon that the two of you have problems...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Our base camp is on an island in the center of the sea. Yakov is still delirious, so I must send him there first.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: And... Oh yes. We... we were part of the team assigned by Researcher Persikov to conduct signal tests here.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: I've heard that one of the Lord Harbingers has learned in Sumeru that we can connect people's minds with the help of certain technologies, and that the impact of such technologies could cover an entire region...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Things weren't looking all that promising, but Researcher Persikov decided to go ahead with these experiments anyway, and we were assigned to go out to sea and carry out signal tests in various places for this machine of ours...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I wonder how those experiments are going...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we are here, so the Fatui experiment...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The experiment is kaput, duh.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: That how it is? Haha, then I guess Researcher Persikov's gonna have to pay that toll.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: That's all I know. I made arrangements with <color=#00E1FFFF>the other team members</color> that we'd go back to our base camp in the center of the sea once we finished testing...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: They should be somewhere on <color=#00E1FFFF>the two islands in the north</color>... According to our mission progress, they're probably on the <color=#00E1FFFF>northwestern island</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Agafya would be crazy mad at me if she saw Yakov like this... But I've got to bring Yakov back no matter what!

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: It's all my fault... I'm the reason he became like that...

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: No, I need to... bring the insignia back to him... I've got to find it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: The insignia... The insignia...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gah, he's completely ignoring us...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A little louder, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's pretty clear that he can't hear us. Speaking louder won't help at all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He acts exactly like Agafya earlier, remember? She came to reason as soon as we gave her the pocket watch with a picture.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe there is also something that can wake the Electrohammer Vanguard from the impact of the machine?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Seems like he's looking for some kind of insignia... Guess we need to find it for him, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.text: (The gramophone is playing songs that bring back warm memories of the past...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, you must be referring to the Fatui we met earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Oh, so you've met them, have you...

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Agafya would be crazy mad at me if she saw Yakov like this... But I've got to bring Yakov back no matter what!

dialogues.speaker: Electrohammer Vanguard
dialogues.text: I gotta find the insignia... That's the only way...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Let's talk to him after we find the insignia...)

talks.objective: Look for traces of the other group's members

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: Have you found a way to open the device? I mean, I'm not rushing you or anything, but... Why, is there something wrong?

choices.text: Why did you all come to the Archipelago...

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: We came here to complete our glorious mission, of course. But as for the details... I'll tell you more after we find Yakov...

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: You mean you think it's strange that I'm so familiar with an insignia that is not even mine...?

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: Well, that badge belongs to Yakov. He went on this mission once together with his father, but he came back alone.

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: He got that insignia after that mission... I envied the honor he won so much that I wound up borrowing it many times. Just to have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: #*sigh*, what am I gonna do about Yakov... What, is there anything else, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Why did you join the Fatui?

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: Why... I joined the Fatui?

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: Well, I did it to help realize the long-cherished wish of Her Royal Highness the Tsaritsa... and to bring more honor to my family. I was raised to fight for the Tsaritsa.

response.speaker: Chevka
response.text: *sigh* It seems that Yakov is still delirious...

dialogues.speaker: Yakov
dialogues.text: Why... Why did you leave me alone, Father... Why...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (He still doesn't seem to be in his right mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: What happened back there? I... don't really understand.

dialogues.speaker: Chevka
dialogues.text: How did it go? Have you found Yakov?
